request_id.description: The unique identifier of the request this response corresponds to.

status.description: Indicates whether the command was executed successfully or if an error occurred.

type.description: The type of the resource packet.

value.description: The value of the resource, structure depends on the type.

response.description: The data returned by the command, encapsulated in ResourcePacket subclass instances. Present only if status is 'success'.

code.description: A code representing the type of error that occurred.

message.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error.

error.description: Details of the error, if any occurred during command execution. Present only if status is 'error'.
